title: Business system brief
summary: A field-by-field brief for scoping websites, CRMs, dashboards and automations before design starts.
body: Use this guide to capture business goals, users, entities, source systems, workflows, reporting needs, edge cases and launch constraints.

title: CRM readiness checklist
summary: A checklist for deciding whether your team needs a spreadsheet cleanup, a lightweight CRM or a custom pipeline system.
body: Before building a CRM, check ownership, lead sources, required stages, follow-up rules, required integrations and reporting obligations.

title: Automation map
summary: A simple worksheet for documenting triggers, actions, failure states and visibility across automation workflows.
body: Every automation should define its trigger, data contract, owner, retries, notifications and manual fallback path.
